correctness.rationale: PASS: For rooted ultrametric height H, V0=V1=Vn=0 and all variances nonnegative; two nonadjacent strict internal peaks require n>=5. On the fully specified five-tip topology, exact PD(S) as a sum of six clade-intersection indicators yields displayed quadratic forms V2,V3,V4. Their two differences are exactly the stated homogeneous quadratic inequalities for strict peaks at k=2,4. A fresh exact-Fraction independent subset enumeration at (alpha,beta,gamma)=(14/15,1/3,2/5) obtained variances (0,0,32/375,317/4500,28/375,0) and two strict peaks. Source check.py uses all combinations and symbolic coefficient vectors, so the phase law is a finite polynomial identity over continuous depths, not extrapolation from sample triples. Strictly positive edge lengths and no root stem were verified.
